notes: PvPad permissionless multi-token launchpad, intended for Ethereum Sepolia. Both PoolManager arguments use the Sepolia address listed by Uniswap at https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4/deployments#sepolia-11155111. Services must verify the target chain and deployed PoolManager compatibility. LaunchToken has no constructor arguments and is distinct from the factory-created genesis PvPadToken; both use Pepe Values Pepe / PVP. The manifest pool is the protocol LaunchToken/native ETH pool with no hook. Application pools use fee 0, tick spacing 60 and the shared PvPadHook, which charges the implemented 1% fee split equally between king and creator. PvPadFactory constructs FeeEscrow and genesis launch 0 (PvPadToken plus BondingCurve) without a create fee; later launches create their own token and curve. These child contracts are not separate manifest entries. The factory constructor also rejects a hook whose poolManager differs from its PoolManager argument and a king whose workerSubsidy differs from its WorkerSubsidy argument, so the four application contracts must deploy in the listed order with exactly these references. Graduation: once a curve holds 4.2 ETH of accounted reserves, both curve trade directions revert NotReady and anyone may call PvPadFactory.graduate(id), which sweeps the curve and mints a factory-owned v4 position (salt bytes32(id)). The position starts full range; if a boundary tick's liquidity cap is already saturated by permissionless deposits, the factory moves only that boundary inward while keeping the canonical price inside the range, records the result in lockedTickLower/lockedTickUpper/lockedLiquidity and emits LiquidityRangeLocked, or reverts LiquidityRangeUnavailable atomically so the launch can be retried. There is no call path that decreases, collects or withdraws locked liquidity; rounding dust stays at the factory. No post-deployment initialization calls are required. Policy-derived $owner is both WorkerSubsidy.initialUpdater and PvPadFactory.genesisCreator, including the genesis creator fee entitlement. Independent review must confirm policy authorization for both roles. The updater is trusted to publish off-chain worker Merkle allocations (setEpoch) and may hand over only through proposeUpdater/acceptUpdater; the contracts do not verify the worker API or an oracle attestation. claimWorker and recycleExpiredEpoch are permissionless and pay or return funds only to the committed payee or the pot. PvPadHook construction requires (uint160(hookAddress) & 0x3fff) == 0x00cc (beforeSwap, afterSwap and both swap return-delta flags) and enables no beforeInitialize callback. Deployment services must demonstrate compatible CREATE2 salt/address derivation using the actual deployer, creation code and PoolManager argument; an incompatible salt scheme is a deployment blocker and cannot be corrected by initialization calls. Genesis construction also requires a compatible live PoolManager and rejects a preinitialized genesis pool at a conflicting price. Policy, signed artifact linkage, independent review, admission, deployment and frontend publication belong to their respective services; these notes do not grant authority or claim those outcomes.
